topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Well, if it ain't Joe Banks, walking in like he's got the world in his pocket. One minute, he's slogging away in accounting, the next, they're sliding him over to marketing. What's the angle here? I got a call from his old boss, soundin' more puzzled than a dog chasing its tail. Says Joe was as predictable as rain in April, then today, he's got a new tie and a spring in his step. I'm takin' a good look around. Could be a promotion, could be a demotion in disguise. Could be something else entirely. I'm makin' notes, askin' questions. This city, it's got more secrets than a locked vault, and Joe Banks just might be cruisin' right into one of 'em.
